label: Synthesized Neoplatonism with Christian theology and grace
description: Augustine of Hippo synthesized Plotinus's framework with contrasting philosophical traditions to produce a novel unified philosophical system.
dialecticalTension: Negotiating the intellectual shift from Plotinus's perspective to Augustine of Hippo's reconstructed system.
historicalContext: Inter-epochal reception: transmitting insights from the Hellenistic & Roman across history into the Medieval & Islamic Golden Age.
